story_type: explosive door breaching with water charges, Marine training school
hook: Marines blew this door open with a charge built around water.
narration: Marines blew this door off its frame with a charge built around water.
This was the Methods of Entry School at Marine Corps Base Quantico, Virginia.
They set the charge on a pole against the door and stacked up behind a shield.
Water does not compress, so the blast pushes across the whole door at once.
Then the stack moved through the smoke and into the building.
outcome: The water charges blew the doors open, and the Marines went in.
title: Marines blow doors open with water
description:
Marines make and use water charge explosives to breach a house at the Methods of Entry School on Marine Corps Base Quantico, Virginia, Jan. 31, 2018.
